verdict.rationale: The docs describe generating report types such as briefing documents, study guides, FAQs, custom and AI-suggested reports [27][3], along with auto-generated summaries [5]. Results can be shared by exporting notes to Google Docs or Sheets [13] or by sharing a public notebook link [8]. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that reports contain structured sections and tables, and independent or hands-on confirmation of report quality and sharing workflow.
